production.direction_en: A red-vial mercenary tips a flask into the village well. Fadyme raises her silver bell focus; the spell takes more from her than she lets anyone see.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_tension | post: bgm_quiet_sorrow — very quiet; the red on the gauntlet is not scored, leave room

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: There is red on my gauntlet.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: Then the enemy finally managed to hit you.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: I wiped my own blood on his glove. He must not count the drops.
